cases.title: Corrected ancestor identified
cases.action: Inspect current local/remote refs and correction diff.
cases.expected: Record actual correction SHA; verified Pass-2 lineage; no reset to the uncorrected anchor.

cases.title: Privacy fix passes before edits
cases.action: Run the three audited cases through the actual current RAEON/Horizon/Hypervisor.
cases.expected: Public stays public for private-capable actor, inspections stay private, private_to stays filtered.

cases.title: No concurrent writer race
cases.action: Inspect current task/worktree ownership and unfinished changes.
cases.expected: Wait rather than modifying files owned by the running correction; preserve all changes.

cases.title: Baseline retained
cases.action: Run previous runtime, Pass-1/2 and corrected privacy tests before changes.
cases.expected: Record actual baseline commands/results; no historical PASS copied as new execution.

cases.title: Upstream read-only
cases.action: Verify upstream pin and tracked-source status before/after.
cases.expected: No _bricked edits/commits; isolated dependencies used; sources unchanged.

cases.title: Full source inventory
cases.action: Load every consumed dataset and original manifest.
cases.expected: All consumed bytes available/hashed; metadata-only files read locally; counts/statuses preserved.

cases.title: Lossless index
cases.action: Build and query the derived index from original records.
cases.expected: Original addresses and fields unchanged; deterministic rebuild; originals hash-identical.

cases.title: Known base lookup
cases.action: Query M-R-01 by manifold ID and QMO address.
cases.expected: Same source row and FG-001/044/117 membership returned without claiming a pose witness.

cases.title: Known fusion lookup
cases.action: Read M-O-01+M-O-02 and resolve its derived ID.
cases.expected: Existing eight-generator VIOLET source result and support IDs match independently read data.

cases.title: Missing/negative source outcomes
cases.action: Query absent record and source-declared invalid/not-applicable cases.
cases.expected: OPEN for absent data; explicit supplied outcomes retained, never silently converted to VALID/TERMINATES.

cases.title: Corpus integrity refusal
cases.action: Alter a required catalog record/manifest/index in a temporary test copy.
cases.expected: Integrity error before use; no production source or state mutation.

cases.title: Mapping provenance recovered
cases.action: Inspect original algorithm/face/frame/closure sources and derived mapping tests.
cases.expected: Every admission predicate has source or justified deterministic derivation; discretionary gaps explicitly recorded.

cases.title: Exact data values
cases.action: Round-trip record IDs, source signatures and large seeds through chosen loaders.
cases.expected: No lossy numeric conversion, arbitrary renaming or source status promotion.

cases.title: No regeneration
cases.action: Compare canonical FG/QMO source files before/after build.
cases.expected: All original bytes remain unchanged; no invented QMO rows used to satisfy fixtures.

cases.title: Native deployed-copy hydration
cases.action: Deploy an actual FG-001 via Pass-2 operations and obtain its geometry view.
cases.expected: Preserve copy ID/owner/history; stored occupancy/void/faces/color mapping agree with source, not a universal fake template.

cases.title: Same definition different copies
cases.action: Deploy allowed duplicates across the two owners.
cases.expected: Distinct persistent instance identities with one shared immutable definition reference.

cases.title: XY only position
cases.action: Submit valid XY and an unexpected positional Z.
cases.expected: XY schema round-trips; Z input rejected; no implicit 3D position/CAD control.

cases.title: Genuine 3D orientation
cases.action: Set rotations affecting more than one axis using an admitted mapping.
cases.expected: State and face correspondence reflect full 3D orientation, not yaw-only or color selection.

cases.title: Numeric boundary validation
cases.action: Try nonfinite/malformed/overflow/unknown-encoding pose components.
cases.expected: Reject before mutation; exact integer wire behavior or versioned extension enforced.

cases.title: Rotation equivalence
cases.action: Apply two equivalent encodings under declared canonicalization.
cases.expected: Same canonical pose and evidence; no nondeterministic identity churn.

cases.title: Reflection not rotation
cases.action: Submit an improper reflection as an ordinary rotation.
cases.expected: Rejected or separately handled only if source explicitly permits it; source chirality/parity not silently flipped.

cases.title: Pose ownership
cases.action: Attempt pose update on other player or undeployed/unknown card.
cases.expected: Denied with prior root/card/pose state unchanged.

cases.title: No free extraction
cases.action: Use pose operation to target another configuration space.
cases.expected: Denied; committed card stays in its existing space.

cases.title: All-or-none pose batch
cases.action: Submit a batch with one invalid/foreign/stale copy.
cases.expected: No partial pose updates; grants, old edges and field eligibility unchanged.

cases.title: Stale pose precondition
cases.action: Race or replay a pose update against old space revision.
cases.expected: Conflict/idempotent result as appropriate; no lost update.

cases.title: Actual Genesis operation
cases.action: Remove/tamper the pose handler or declared effect in a temporary fixture.
cases.expected: Execution fails or asserted behavior changes; no unrelated Python-only pose success.

cases.title: One/two FG nonclosure
cases.action: Query spaces with one and then two copies.
cases.expected: No ordinary active field; source-backed partial edges may be shown.

cases.title: Candidate membership vs pose
cases.action: Provide the M-R-01 membership with an unverified pose.
cases.expected: Return candidate membership only; current field not active without pose/closure proof.

cases.title: Wrong family
cases.action: Replace a required copy with a source-nonmember while querying the named candidate.
cases.expected: Named candidate membership fails; cards not removed; other candidates handled independently.

cases.title: Wrong orientation
cases.action: Start from a known valid witness and rotate one FG into a known nonadmitted facing.
cases.expected: Pose gate fails while membership still matches; no stale active field.

cases.title: Live edge evidence
cases.action: Inspect partial edge output after known valid face alignment.
cases.expected: Edges reference actual copy faces, source record and current pose revisions.

cases.title: No color-only edge rule
cases.action: Use same display colors without an admitted source/live facing relation.
cases.expected: No fabricated edge; diagnostic distinguishes candidate from admitted.

cases.title: Simultaneous compatibility
cases.action: Use pairwise-compatible edges lacking one simultaneous current assignment.
cases.expected: No global field proof from independently satisfiable pairs.

cases.title: Multiset-safe lookup
cases.action: Query duplicate definitions with distinct copy IDs and surplus copies.
cases.expected: Multiplicity/leftovers handled by source rule; no deduplication or silent subset discard.

cases.title: Complete candidate results
cases.action: Compare indexed results against an independent read-only exhaustive finite scan.
cases.expected: Same source candidate set; stable order; ambiguity retained instead of arbitrary active topology selection.

cases.title: Query has no gameplay side effect
cases.action: Repeat queries/preview/hints at the same state.
cases.expected: No semantic revision advance, duplicate Geometrics, field activation, healing or refresh.

cases.title: Bounded search
cases.action: Exhaust a configured query/witness budget.
cases.expected: Explicit incomplete/budget result; never NO_MATCH/TERMINATES solely from timeout.

cases.title: Stale query/witness cache
cases.action: Change member, pose, source mapping or view after caching.
cases.expected: Cache invalidated or revalidated using full dependency stamp; no old witness accepted.

cases.title: Source-backed real field
cases.action: Run the complete correct-member+pose closure scenario through Genesis.
cases.expected: One distinct runtime field exists with actual witness and QMO-native color.

cases.title: Both resolution gates enforced
cases.action: Independently fail membership and pose in separate cases.
cases.expected: Neither case can activate field; both statuses/reasons are distinguishable.

cases.title: Count is not proof
cases.action: Deploy a legal count in a nonclosing organization.
cases.expected: No active field merely because 3–8 cards exist.

cases.title: Field and space identities separate
cases.action: Resolve, observe and compare space/copy/QMO/field identifiers.
cases.expected: Distinct identity roles; source reused, no space converted into a QMO record.

cases.title: Repeated resolution idempotent
cases.action: Retry committed resolve request and reobserve unchanged scene.
cases.expected: Same result/activation; no duplicate field or extra mutation.

cases.title: Reopen after member change
cases.action: Add a permitted FG to a resolved space through current operation path.
cases.expected: Old witness invalid; nonempty unresolved space CONFIGURING; copies conserved.

cases.title: Reopen after pose change
cases.action: Apply admitted pose update that breaks prior closure.
cases.expected: Old field ineligible before next projection; cards remain in same space.

cases.title: No failure graveyard penalty
cases.action: Attempt a nonclosing configuration or rejected resolution.
cases.expected: No automatic retirement/lost copies or unrelated side effects.

cases.title: Color/availability separation
cases.action: Requery/reconfigure an existing same-topology field with mutable state.
cases.expected: Native source rank immutable; no implicit heal/charge/refresh through query or resolution.

cases.title: Ordinary color mapping
cases.action: Resolve independently selected valid ordinary 3–8-card witnesses.
cases.expected: Colors follow each source QMO; eight is Violet, count never grants closure.

cases.title: Atomic dependent invalidation
cases.action: Break support closure while an emergent references it.
cases.expected: Field eligibility and incident emergents change in one committed visible successor.

cases.title: Merge preview is read-only
cases.action: Preview source-backed and policy-missing merge requests.
cases.expected: Records exact input IDs/union/width/policy gaps; no state/card changes.

cases.title: Actual two-to-one merge
cases.action: Merge two valid source spaces using supplied capacity/accounting/frame rules.
cases.expected: Independent-space count falls by one, all actual copy IDs/owners/history retained.

cases.title: No copy deduplication
cases.action: Merge spaces with distinct copies sharing an FG definition.
cases.expected: All copy IDs survive; unresolved multiplicity does not delete extra copies.

cases.title: Source-derived fusion only
cases.action: Choose a valid pair-table result and a missing/not-applicable pair.
cases.expected: Only current source/pose-admitted result activates; missing is not invented.

cases.title: Merged pose frames
cases.action: Merge under the accepted local-frame conversion.
cases.expected: Relative poses transformed/revalidated explicitly; no arbitrary snap/collision rule.

cases.title: Missing capacity/base policy refuses safely
cases.action: Omit required capacity/accounting policy.
cases.expected: Return explicit policy gate; no inference from max-nine or field count, no automatic base replenishment.

cases.title: Same-owner distinct sources
cases.action: Try same space twice, consumed space, and cross-owner pair.
cases.expected: All invalid requests rejected atomically.

cases.title: Width and nine-space cap
cases.action: Combine expansion/merge sequence under accepted policy.
cases.expected: Persistent region identity; no static A/B/C ceiling; cap maintained without inventing a merge minimum.

cases.title: Merge rollback and retry
cases.action: Inject failure after native transfers/prepublication, then retry a committed request.
cases.expected: Complete rollback before commit; committed retry has exactly one width cost.

cases.title: Old support invalidation
cases.action: Merge fields with incident emergents.
cases.expected: Old independent fields cease operation; affected emergents invalidated; history remains.

cases.title: No unapproved split/recursive fusion
cases.action: Request split/unfusion or unsupported derived-support recursion.
cases.expected: No operation invented; explicit source/policy refusal with preserved state.

cases.title: Read source pair separately
cases.action: Look up eligible and ineligible support combinations.
cases.expected: Retain source types/status/support IDs; pair lookup is not a new construction puzzle.

cases.title: Real passive emergent
cases.action: Link two actual active source-backed runtime fields.
cases.expected: Source-defined emergent appears with verified supports; no extra Configuration Space.

cases.title: Supports retained
cases.action: Observe before/after admitted link.
cases.expected: Both source fields/spaces/copy sets remain distinct and independently present.

cases.title: Stable link identity
cases.action: Retry link and reverse unordered support order where source symmetry permits.
cases.expected: No duplicate emergent/link; source direction preserved when relevant.

cases.title: Multiple instances of same QMO
cases.action: Link separate allowed runtime support pairs with matching source definitions.
cases.expected: Runtime links do not alias just because QMO address is shared.

cases.title: Three source-backed pairwise emergents
cases.action: Run independently selected supported AB/AC/BC triple.
cases.expected: Three emergents and original three spaces; no fabricated dataset row.

cases.title: Selective support loss
cases.action: Reconfigure A to lose its active support in the triple.
cases.expected: AB/AC ineligible, BC unchanged if still supported; no dangling references.

cases.title: Non-targetability enforced
cases.action: Query/request a direct destructive target against emergent type.
cases.expected: No independently attackable/retirable emergent; capability/type boundary rejects it.

cases.title: No recursive emergent source loophole
cases.action: Use an emergent as input support where corpus admits only local fields.
cases.expected: Refuse unsupported recursion without changing source tables.

cases.title: Link rollback/retry
cases.action: Inject failure during creation or dependency update and repeat committed request.
cases.expected: Atomic prior graph on failure; exactly-once visible link on retry.

cases.title: No premature color cadence
cases.action: Observe active emergents across requests.
cases.expected: No new charge/tap/refresh/reaction scheduler introduced in Pass 3.

cases.title: Owner/private with public-capable objects
cases.action: Query actual own deployed topology from owner-private and opponent views.
cases.expected: Only authorized data/objects appear; hidden opponent cards never enumerated.

cases.title: Public selected by private-capable actor
cases.action: Observe/query/hint after actor can access private Hand.
cases.expected: Selected public view contains no Hand identities/details or private derived hint.

cases.title: Inspection remains view-scoped
cases.action: Make private inspection then observe public in same and reconnect sessions.
cases.expected: No inspection contents in public/opponent/cache/event/result.

cases.title: Private relationship filter survives topology stage
cases.action: Append dynamic space/field/link projections.
cases.expected: No filtered private_to relation reintroduced.

cases.title: Dynamic nine-space visibility
cases.action: Create allowed extra spaces then observe all authorized views.
cases.expected: New space identities filtered consistently; cap and original identities preserved.

cases.title: Feedback without legality
cases.action: Render-neutral query of candidate vs admitted tether.
cases.expected: Different typed statuses; suggestion never mutates pose/field or grants closure.

cases.title: No native diagnostics leak
cases.action: Inspect byte snapshots/deltas/events/errors/query receipts.
cases.expected: No backend paths/resources/grants/private raw witness content inappropriate to view.

cases.title: Reconnections and cache separation
cases.action: Switch public/private/public and restore epoch.
cases.expected: No cross-view cache reuse; stale versions request resync correctly.

cases.title: Unsupported emergent not shown active
cases.action: Observe after support mutation at same committed revision.
cases.expected: No visible stale active emergent while required support is inactive.

cases.title: Real byte round trip
cases.action: Set/query/resolve through actual player Hypervisor sessions.
cases.expected: Inputs are intentions; actual Genesis handlers/native backend create results, not a fake response.

cases.title: Complete candidate rollback
cases.action: Inject faults after poses/edges/field/link candidates and before root replacement.
cases.expected: Restore all semantic values/grants/witnesses/memberships/history references; no partial graph.

cases.title: Post-commit delivery recovery
cases.action: Lose response after field/link/merge commit, retry identical request.
cases.expected: Stored outcome returned; no duplicate field/link/merge/mutation.

cases.title: Concurrent stale changes
cases.action: Submit competing pose/resolve or pose/merge requests.
cases.expected: Serializable commit or explicit stale refusal; no lost update/invalid support snapshot.

cases.title: Nonempty new-process restore
cases.action: Checkpoint actual cards/poses/fields/links and restore elsewhere.
cases.expected: Same semantic identities, witness dependencies and support graph; new boundary epoch.

cases.title: Witness/checkpoint ABI tamper
cases.action: Alter source mapping/witness/recovery metadata in temporary copy.
cases.expected: Fail closed; live original root remains intact.

cases.title: Deterministic replay across paths
cases.action: Replay same accepted inputs/seeds at distinct physical roots.
cases.expected: Same semantic field/pose/support results; host metadata excluded.

cases.title: Finite budgets/no silent failure
cases.action: Exceed search, graph or transaction resource budgets.
cases.expected: Explicit bounded outcome, no partial mutation; no new arbitrary gameplay capacity.

cases.title: Earlier tests retained
cases.action: Rerun runtime/Pass-1/2 and all corrected privacy regressions.
cases.expected: All prior supported behavior passes or exact preexisting baseline failure is independently disclosed; no suppressed validators.

cases.title: All new Genesis compiled
cases.action: Enumerate manifest/import/native helper source and build twice.
cases.expected: Actual supported compiler/verifier accepts every shipped source; deterministic hashes; no skipped handler.

cases.title: Whole corpus/data integrity checks
cases.action: Run current repository validators and source-index cross-checks.
cases.expected: No original FG/atlas/compatibility/pair data changes; actual test counts recorded.

cases.title: Paired package inventory
cases.action: Build both distributions from clean source commit.
cases.expected: Required QMO/mapping/runtime slice present; matching ABI/version records; exact safe manifests, no caches/secrets.

cases.title: Offline cold build and new query
cases.action: Deny original repo reads/network/DNS/Git; cold build and uncached topology run.
cases.expected: Run uses only packaged inputs/declared prerequisites; no hidden external fetch.

cases.title: Missing essential local input
cases.action: Remove temporary-copy required QMO/mapper/runtime input.
cases.expected: Explicit dependency failure and no fallback fetch; restore test copy.

cases.title: Installed scene recovery
cases.action: Run nonempty topology restart from fresh extraction, not checkout.
cases.expected: Source-independent recovery and selected-view privacy pass within supported host.

cases.title: Actual source evidence and receipt
cases.action: Join unchanged acceptance IDs to commands/logs/hashes and policy results.
cases.expected: NOT_RUN/BLOCKED positives never counted as PASS; receipt reports actual capability and Pass-4 entry.

cases.title: Corrected lineage and remote persistence
cases.action: Verify start/corrected/implementation/receipt/remote SHAs after push.
cases.expected: Corrected Pass-2 ancestor retained; all maintained work in _raeon; main untouched; clean authorized task branch.

cases.title: Continuity updated without false completion
cases.action: Update execution/current state and next-thread instructions.
cases.expected: Ready for Pass 4 only on demonstrated completion; otherwise exact next failing command/gate preserved.
